assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE new photorealistic grading example asset for an internal laptop inspection app, matching the Dell laptop in the provided reference image. Reference image is the identity/composition anchor, not a damage example. Show the same gray Dell Latitude-style laptop lid, same Dell logo, same hinges, same lid proportions and centered rear-facing view as the reference. Change only the condition: a clear structural fracture runs diagonally across the upper right quarter of the lid, with a small split in the outer shell, not superficial scratches. This is the 'broken lid cover' example. Keep the rest of the lid undamaged, no missing hinge or other unrelated defect. Full lid entirely visible, very small white margins, landscape 3:2, pure white #ffffff seamless background right to every edge, no gray vignette, soft neutral studio illumination. No arrows, inset, labels, text, grade letters, colored marks, watermarks or scene props. Preserve the product identity and professional neutral documentary product-photo style. Output a single image, not a collage.

Use case: product-mockup. Generate ONE new photorealistic internal laptop grading example. Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a photorealistic CLOSE-UP inspection photo from this exact gray Dell laptop reference. Crop to the FRONT RIGHT CORNER of the nearly closed laptop, NOT the rear hinge area: show the metal lid rim, base rim and their closing seam prominently. The thin RIGID painted metal lid shell is twisted at this corner so its rim sits 8 mm above the flat base, while the adjacent straight edge progressively closes normally: a clearly uneven wedge-shaped opening, not an evenly half-open laptop. Show a crisp permanent shallow bend in the thin manufactured metal lid edge and a modest scrape revealing solid bright metal at the bend. Preserve regular solid wall thickness, flat base, realistic recess inside closing seam. NO bloated bulge, melted clay, rounded putty, thick rolled edge, torn foil, ripples or added missing pieces. No visible hinge damage or broken glass; the only problem is warped lid alignment preventing closure. Preserve reference finish, color and realistic surface texture. Oblique near-side view with defect in sharp focus, honest softly lit inspection photography, white surroundings if visible. Only this inspected corner in frame, whole laptop not required. No logo, text, markings, arrows, inset, hands, props, fake effects or CGI. Landscape 3:2.
